author: blu
body: What is NOT here, stated rather than implied: fragmentation REASSEMBLY. The header carries fragment_offset and fragment_length and the parser reads them, but this chapter emits only unfragmented messages and does not reassemble a fragmented peer flight. A handshake message larger than the path MTU will therefore fail against a peer that fragments. That is a real gap and it must not be described as working.

author: blu
body: Nor is there any peer authentication. A Finished that verifies proves the peer holds the same handshake secret; it says nothing about who the peer is. The credential question is still open.
